style_notes: Source typography, geometry, theme, logos, and diagram meaning are retained.

opaque_areas: Fabric reference architecture diagram, platform marks, icons, connectors, and faded source emphasis remain fixed artwork. Editable labels follow the source technical layout.
retained_source_content: Footer/legal line and slide number are source-bound.

limitations: Fixed source geometry and binding cardinality; no dynamic reflow or variable item count.

Retained source logos, branded diagrams, and source-specific claims require review before client use.
